caption: The drawing depicts a metal object consisting of a flat, elongated horizontal base supported by four legs, bent to form right angles at the junction with the base, resembling a low table or stable platform. Two sets of arched metal rods are attached vertically to the base, with one larger arch positioned centrally and a smaller arch within the larger one. Attached to one end of the base is a long, narrow, and flat horizontal extension. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a monochromatic appearance, and is depicted against a plain, light background with no additional elements. The drawing is executed with fine lines and detailed shading to convey texture and depth.
title: Toast Rack
